# E06 线性相关与线性无关

完整知识单元课堂参考草稿，按数学内容选择组织方式。本示例仅供理解教学行为，实际项目应重新设计板书、布局、动画和节奏；关联题规则以当前项目为准。以下代码尚未经过真实成片验收。

```python title=scene_01
from manim import *
from animation_engine.code.authored_scene import AuthoredScene
from animation_engine.code.board_kit import board_bounds, fit_stem, mixed_text, fit_into_region

class E06Part1(AuthoredScene):
    def construct(self):
        self.camera.background_color = WHITE
        bounds = board_bounds()
        heading = Text("线性相关与线性无关", color=BLACK, font_size=34)
        fit_stem(heading, bounds)
        self.add(heading)
        self.start_cue("E06_1_1", "研究向量组时，关心的是这些向量之间是否存在非平凡的线性组合等于零。", "", tts_text="研究向量组时，关心的是这些向量之间是否存在非平凡的线性组合等于零。")
        line_1 = MathTex(r"c_1v_1+\cdots+c_mv_m=0", color=BLACK, font_size=34)
        fit_into_region(line_1, top_y=heading.get_bottom()[1]-0.45, bottom_y=bounds["board_floor_y"], left_x=bounds["left_x"], right_x=bounds["right_x"], align_top=True)
        self.play(Write(line_1), run_time=min(0.85, self.cue_time_left()*0.55))
        self.check_layout("E06_1_1", heading=heading, line1=line_1)
        self.end_cue("E06_1_1")
        self.start_cue("E06_1_2", "若存在不全为零的系数使等式成立，则线性相关；否则线性无关。", "", tts_text="若存在不全为零的系数使等式成立，则线性相关；否则线性无关。")
        line_2 = Text("相关：存在非零系数；无关：只有全零系数", color=BLACK, font_size=28)
        line_2.next_to(line_1, DOWN, buff=0.36, aligned_edge=LEFT)
        self.play(Write(line_2), run_time=min(0.85, self.cue_time_left()*0.55))
        self.check_layout("E06_1_2", heading=heading, line1=line_1, line2=line_2)
        self.end_cue("E06_1_2")
```

```python title=scene_02
from manim import *
from animation_engine.code.authored_scene import AuthoredScene
from animation_engine.code.board_kit import board_bounds, fit_stem, mixed_text, fit_into_region

class E06Part2(AuthoredScene):
    def construct(self):
        self.camera.background_color = WHITE
        bounds = board_bounds()
        heading = Text("线性相关与线性无关", color=BLACK, font_size=34)
        fit_stem(heading, bounds)
        self.add(heading)
        self.start_cue("E06_2_1", "两个向量中，一个若为另一个的倍数，就存在非平凡关系。例如二乘第一个减去第二个等于零。", "", tts_text="两个向量中，一个若为另一个的倍数，就存在非平凡关系。例如二乘第一个减去第二个等于零。")
        line_1 = MathTex(r"v_2=2v_1\Rightarrow2v_1-v_2=0", color=BLACK, font_size=34)
        fit_into_region(line_1, top_y=heading.get_bottom()[1]-0.45, bottom_y=bounds["board_floor_y"], left_x=bounds["left_x"], right_x=bounds["right_x"], align_top=True)
        self.play(Write(line_1), run_time=min(0.85, self.cue_time_left()*0.55))
        self.check_layout("E06_2_1", heading=heading, line1=line_1)
        self.end_cue("E06_2_1")
        self.start_cue("E06_2_2", "含有零向量的向量组一定线性相关。相关并不要求所有系数都非零。", "", tts_text="含有零向量的向量组一定线性相关。相关并不要求所有系数都非零。")
        line_2 = Text("至少一个系数非零即可", color=BLACK, font_size=28)
        line_2.next_to(line_1, DOWN, buff=0.36, aligned_edge=LEFT)
        self.play(Write(line_2), run_time=min(0.85, self.cue_time_left()*0.55))
        self.check_layout("E06_2_2", heading=heading, line1=line_1, line2=line_2)
        self.end_cue("E06_2_2")
        self.start_cue("E06_2_3", "如果只能取全零系数，则向量组无关。可以通过齐次方程组判断。", "", tts_text="如果只能取全零系数，则向量组无关。可以通过齐次方程组判断。")
        line_3 = MathTex(r"Ac=0", color=BLACK, font_size=34)
        line_3.next_to(line_2, DOWN, buff=0.36, aligned_edge=LEFT)
        self.play(Write(line_3), run_time=min(0.85, self.cue_time_left()*0.55))
        self.check_layout("E06_2_3", heading=heading, line1=line_1, line2=line_2, line3=line_3)
        self.end_cue("E06_2_3")
```

```python title=scene_03
from manim import *
from animation_engine.code.authored_scene import AuthoredScene
from animation_engine.code.board_kit import board_bounds, fit_stem, mixed_text, fit_into_region

class E06Part3(AuthoredScene):
    def construct(self):
        self.camera.background_color = WHITE
        bounds = board_bounds()
        heading = Text("线性相关与线性无关", color=BLACK, font_size=34)
        fit_stem(heading, bounds)
        self.add(heading)
        self.start_cue("E06_3_1", "例题：判断一零与零一这两个二维向量是否线性无关。", "", tts_text="例题：判断一零与零一这两个二维向量是否线性无关。")
        line_1 = MathTex(r"v_1=(1,0),\quad v_2=(0,1)", color=BLACK, font_size=34)
        fit_into_region(line_1, top_y=heading.get_bottom()[1]-0.45, bottom_y=bounds["board_floor_y"], left_x=bounds["left_x"], right_x=bounds["right_x"], align_top=True)
        self.play(Write(line_1), run_time=min(0.85, self.cue_time_left()*0.55))
        self.check_layout("E06_3_1", heading=heading, line1=line_1)
        self.end_cue("E06_3_1")
        self.start_cue("E06_3_2", "令线性组合等于零，得到 c 一和 c 二都等于零，因此无关。", "", tts_text="令线性组合等于零，得到 c 一和 c 二都等于零，因此无关。")
        line_2 = MathTex(r"(c_1,c_2)=(0,0)", color=BLACK, font_size=34)
        line_2.next_to(line_1, DOWN, buff=0.36, aligned_edge=LEFT)
        self.play(Write(line_2), run_time=min(0.85, self.cue_time_left()*0.55))
        self.check_layout("E06_3_2", heading=heading, line1=line_1, line2=line_2)
        self.end_cue("E06_3_2")
```

```python title=scene_04
from manim import *
from animation_engine.code.authored_scene import AuthoredScene
from animation_engine.code.board_kit import board_bounds, fit_stem, mixed_text, fit_into_region

class E06Part4(AuthoredScene):
    def construct(self):
        self.camera.background_color = WHITE
        bounds = board_bounds()
        heading = Text("线性相关与线性无关", color=BLACK, font_size=34)
        fit_stem(heading, bounds)
        self.add(heading)
        self.start_cue("E06_4_1", "核心判断：能否找到不全为零的系数，使线性组合为零。不要把存在零系数误认为线性相关。", "", tts_text="核心判断：能否找到不全为零的系数，使线性组合为零。不要把存在零系数误认为线性相关。")
        line_1 = Text("列方程 → 判断非零解", color=BLACK, font_size=28)
        fit_into_region(line_1, top_y=heading.get_bottom()[1]-0.45, bottom_y=bounds["board_floor_y"], left_x=bounds["left_x"], right_x=bounds["right_x"], align_top=True)
        line_1.set_color("#1D4ED8")
        self.play(Write(line_1), run_time=min(0.85, self.cue_time_left()*0.55))
        self.check_layout("E06_4_1", heading=heading, line1=line_1)
        self.end_cue("E06_4_1")
```
